snapshot.title: Bug: PostHog page opens with refused connection after mission
snapshot.description: After a mission completes, a PostHog page opens in the browser but shows a refused connection error. Should not redirect to PostHog or any external URL mid-session.

acceptanceCriteria.text: PostHog events fire silently without opening a new tab or page
No refused connection error is visible to the player after mission
